Strategy: Midrange-targeted preference: score falls with the distance between a bin's residual and the midpoint of the smallest and largest feasible residuals, so the item goes to a middle-of-range bin while both the tightest and the roomiest bins are preserved. It can fail when the extremes are outliers, pulling items into bins that are neither tight nor roomy.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    t = (min(bins) + max(bins)) / 2
    return [-abs(r - t) for r in bins]
```
